Interface Mouse

All Known Implementing Classes:
NativeMouse
public interface Mouse
USB HID mouse control. ArduinoUno.getMouse() is the board's own mouse, which the compiler lowers to the Arduino Mouse library, and ArduinoNano.getMouse() is the Nano ESP32's, lowered to its core's USBHIDMouse; M5StackCardputer.getMouse() uses the same ESP32-S3 stack; a unit test passes mock(Mouse.class) instead. Requires a board with native USB: the UNO R4 WiFi, with the Mouse library installed (arduino-cli lib install Mouse), or an ESP32-S3 board such as the Nano ESP32 and M5Stack Cardputer. Get the board's mouse once, at startup, and pass it to the classes that need it.

    • move

      void move(int x, int y)
      Moves the host cursor by (x, y) pixels, relative to its current position. Each value is narrowed to the underlying signed char range (-128..127, low 8 bits, sign-extended) to match Mouse_::move(signed char, signed char, signed char); keep both arguments within that range to avoid wraparound.
